ordered.title: An exhaust leak isn't just about noise - it can be dangerous
ordered.description: An exhaust leak isn't just about noise - it can be dangerous. Leaks before the catalytic converter or oxygen sensor can affect emissions, fuel economy, and potentially allow carbon monoxide into the cabin.

blocks.text: In our 24,650 quote dataset, we identified four primary causes:

items: Manifold gasket leak (25% of cases) - Ticking noise from engine bay. Cost: £100-£300.
Exhaust pipe leak (30% of cases) - Hissing noise under the car. Cost: £25-£600.
Back box/silencer failure (25% of cases) - Rumbling/booming noise. Cost: £80-£300.
Catalytic converter failure (20% of cases) - Rattling and emissions light. Cost: £500-£2,500+.

blocks.text: The critical rule: "Any exhaust leak is an MOT failure. The bigger concern is carbon monoxide entering the cabin."

cards.text: “A noisy exhaust is just a nuisance - I'll fix it later.” A leak affects emissions, fuel economy, and can allow CO into the cabin. Fix it promptly.

cards.text: “I'll just patch it with exhaust repair paste.” Patches are temporary. If it's structural, it needs proper replacement.

cards.text: “The noise is coming from the back box - cheap fix.” Sometimes. But ticking from the engine bay is usually a manifold leak - more expensive.

ordered.description: If you smell exhaust fumes inside the car:

items: OPEN WINDOWS IMMEDIATELY - Get fresh air into the cabin
PULL OVER SAFELY - Find a safe location
GET IT REPAIRED - Do not drive until the leak is fixed
Carbon monoxide (CO) is odourless and colourless
If you can smell exhaust fumes, CO is present
CO poisoning causes headaches, dizziness, nausea, confusion, and death
Children and pets are more susceptible
Never drive with a leak that allows fumes into the cabin

blocks.question: How much does exhaust leak diagnosis cost in the UK?
blocks.answer: Exhaust leak diagnosis costs £50-£150 at UK independent garages. This includes visual inspection and smoke test.

blocks.question: Can I drive with an exhaust leak?
blocks.answer: If the leak is before the cat or oxygen sensor, it can affect emissions. If you smell fumes inside - stop immediately.

blocks.question: Is an exhaust leak an MOT failure?
blocks.answer: Yes. Any visible exhaust leak or excessive noise is an automatic MOT failure.

blocks.question: How much does back box replacement cost in the UK?
blocks.answer: Back box replacement costs £80-£300 depending on the vehicle and whether it's aftermarket or OEM.

blocks.question: Is exhaust repair paste a permanent fix?
blocks.answer: No. It's temporary. If the pipe is corroded, it needs proper replacement.
